blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-performance-1 (One customer query per invoice (N+1)) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: `customer_label` runs `db.customer(invoice.customer_id)?` (src/report.rs:39), one `SELECT … FROM customers WHERE id = $1` per invoice. Collect the distinct `customer_id`s of the month's invoices, load them in one query with the existing `Db::customers(&[i64])` (`WHERE id = ANY($1)`), index them in a `HashMap<i64, Customer>`, and build each label from that map. The report then runs 3 queries instead of N + 2 (about 3 000 customer queries a month for 800 distinct customers, per the proposal), with the same lines and the same error when a customer is missing.
findings.title: One customer query per invoice (N+1)

findings.evidence:
fn purchase_order(notes: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let pattern = Regex::new(r"PO-\d{4}-\d{4}").expect("a valid pattern");
findings.recommendation: Compile the pattern once — a `static PO: LazyLock<Regex>` (or `OnceLock`), or build it in `monthly_report` before the loop and pass it in. Regex compilation costs far more than the match, and here it runs once per invoice of the month (about 3 000 times per report).
findings.title: The purchase-order regex is compiled once per invoice

findings.recommendation: Weigh the dependency against its use: `PO-` followed by `\d{4}-\d{4}` can be matched by a short scan over `notes` (find `PO-`, then check 4 ASCII digits, `-`, 4 ASCII digits), avoiding `regex` and its transitive crates (`regex-automata`, `regex-syntax`, `aho-corasick`, `memchr`) in build time and binary size. Keep `regex` only if more patterns are expected.
findings.title: The regex crate is added for one fixed-shape pattern

findings.recommendation: `invoices` is owned and not used after the loop: iterate it by value (`for invoice in invoices`) and move `invoice.number` into the line, saving one `String` allocation and copy per invoice.
findings.title: Invoice numbers are cloned while the invoices are dropped
